data.1: Performance Highlights: ▪ Consolidated P&L aggregates the performance of subsidiaries proportion of the performance of associates and joint venture entities within the group. ▪ 55% improvement in consolidated profit before tax was driven by improved performance across 3 major segments. ▪ Trading businesses comprise Longhorn which recorded improvement performance having posted a reduced loss compared to prior year. ▪ Financial services segment registered lower profitability since we no longer consolidate Sidian Bank following an exit that left Centum with a minority stake. The profitability in this segment is attributable to Nabo Capital and Jafari Credit. ▪ Real Estate segment mainly comprise the sale of residential units and development rights by Centum RE. This segment has experienced a lag in revenue recognition which is done upon completion and handover of property to purchasers. ▪ Two Rivers SEZ performance reflects a timing mismatch with expenses having been booked ahead of rent revenue which is expected to reflect in 2HY25and FY2026 as a majority of tenants come into the TRIFIC North Tower. ▪ Investment operations generated Kes 562Mn operating profit largely reflecting interest and dividend income from the portfolio. 29
